name: com.enigma23.arcadetraincontroller
description:
Arcade Train Controller (ATC) is a simple controller asset allowing you to quickly and easily create any type of track vehicle – for example: a train, rollercoaster, monorail, or tram. The customizable arcade-y feel to the movement gives a fun, satisfying, player experience to your game.

Included is a Train Prefab Builder editor window, which allows you to setup a new train in seconds! Just link the required objects and fill in the details, press a button and you’ve got your new vehicle!

Included Demo Vehicles
- Steam train
- Diesel train
- Carriages
- Monorail train with moving doors
